decisions.idea: Canonical initial-portal authority with monotonic supersession
decisions.problem: The currentness receipt detected drift but repeated current records still lacked an explicit single owner authority source and version-regression guard.
decisions.evidence: Three initial portals advanced after v1.7.56; the same identities appear in multiple current surfaces.
decisions.expectedBenefit: One canonical source, derived operating-system artifacts and deterministic regression checks prevent accidental downgrade or cross-surface conflict.
decisions.acceptanceTest: Authority validation reports three advances, one unchanged portal, zero regressions and zero cross-surface conflicts.

decisions.problem: The v1.7.56-generated continuation duplicated opening sections and named v1.7.58 as the next version for a v1.7.58 base.
decisions.user: Roger and the next Smarter Justice builder
decisions.expectedBenefit: One self-contained, non-self-referential v1.7.58-to-v1.7.58 command prevents wrong-base or no-op builds.
decisions.acceptanceTest: Continuation contains one complete handoff opening and names v1.7.58 as the expected next version.

decisions.evidence: All public regression tests pass and preserved route hashes match the source.
decisions.reason: No changes for the sake of changes.
